subject: dxf: add http api to get info of all active tasks for nextgen (#66215)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff (vs parent) and minimal surrounding DXF/storage/server status-handler code. The change adds a read-only status-port GET API `/dxf/task/active` (registered only on SYSTEM keyspace instances) that queries `mysql.tidb_global_task` and returns counts grouped by `keyspace`, using internal-source context; no remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, consistency, compatibility, concurrency, or metadata/state handling.
